'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Stephen Kim DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Kim]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Damp Toes. Transcription note: Username reads "raitha" here and "raith" on the LS sheet (p62) — same player

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Username:''' raitha
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
